Get the population of a country by age group and sex, as saved in the package

Source: R/fct_data.R
saved_pyramid.Rd

The population pyramid of get_pyramid() without internet: Eurostat's population on 1 January by five-year age group and sex (demo_pjangroup) on the day the package was built, for the examples of the charts and to work offline.

Usage

saved_pyramid(country)

Arguments

country

Eurostat code of the country, such as "EL", or "EU27_2020".

Value

A data frame with sex, age, year and value, the share of the age group in the population of its sex, in percent, or NULL when the package has no population pyramids.

Examples

head(saved_pyramid("EL"))
#>      sex   age year    value
#> 1 Female   0-4 1961 8.437061
#> 2 Female   5-9 1961 8.563425
#> 3 Female 10-14 1961 8.626130
#> 4 Female 15-19 1961 7.775774
#> 5 Female 20-24 1961 9.485151
#> 6 Female 25-29 1961 9.410101
